description: DotEnv loader plus specification, one CU per tree. No dependencies; the two trees are disjoint so they run in parallel.
Env.load three-tier precedence and the five object-store keys. Depends on the loader existing in the same tree.
hadoop-aws dependency and Spark fs.s3a wiring. Depends on EnvConfig carrying the object-store fields; independent of wave 2's wiring detail.
Readiness ports, probes, gate and specification. Depends on EnvConfig for probe configuration; independent of the Spark wiring.
Entry-point startup gate. Depends on AppContainer readiness from waves 3 and 4 in the same tree.
